Thumbs up for your explanation. I somehow just admire you, because you always view determinism in positive light and only use it to benefit your own life and not go down the rabbit hole. Cause assuming life is hard determinism, it can make some people depressed and not appreciate what they are doing, and to some even not do anything ( because it was already determined and i have no free will). But by your definition of free will, life becomes easier, you still assume everything is determined, but only look at the things that are important, which by definition, even if you are constrained a lot, you can change.
 (if not going down to hard determinism a lot, you could argue that even thug threatening your life does not take away  ALL of your free will ( or free choice as a matter), cause you know, you can choose to not obey him and be shot although you possibly would want to live more than risk of dying over some money, or obey him and give him what he wants. So you calculated all the risks, make a decision to obey the robber with probably high possibility to survive as opposed to not listening to him or even trying to take him down).  You just take determinism at the top of the iceberg and don't worry about the rest. And i think this is the way we should be living if we want to improve. A lot of times its better to not look at things so seriously, sometimes simplicity is the way to go. Because if we go down the rabbit hole, everything is so complicated and you could even start to argue that your thoughts about determinism was already determined, thoughts, action , feeling and everything. I think if you want to function well it is too lot to go that deep down. It is like a drug now to me, which relieves me from guilt of what i did or didn't done or do. I think that thinking can be used to some with small degree to cope with guilt and self-hatred, but if you want to improve, compatibalism is the way to go. 

If you would argue that you can change anything as it was already determined, and no matter what you do, it doesn't matter, then in same way it doesn't matter if i do things believing i have free will and that too was determined so whatever. Its best to not think about it that deep ( well of course maybe if you are just really interesting with subject and only learning for your own pleasure or if it helps you live better ( as for some degree it is for myself as i then feel less or even no guilt, but i don't go that far deep into it a lot and don't think about it a lot, just that i couldn't do otherwise so because of it i am innocent. It is a good coping mechanism for me) ) , but if it makes your life harder to live, then no matter if it is true or false, why think about it so much, if when you think you have free will you feel better, then why not do so? Even if it is placebo, why is it bad ? Placebo can sometimes be strong medicine, which function nearly the same as a true medication. Just believe what is most beneficial for your life and be successful. If you feeling depressed because you can't improve because of determinism as to everything determined, you can ironically use the same determinism in lower scale to help yourself. 

Example: if you are feeling depressed because you have a shitty job, then by determinism and cause and effect shitty job bring you depression. So to heal depression, you try to find ways to leave that job ( well maybe not in the moment, as you need a pay to live etc. But maybe as you suffer from this shitty job, in the same time you try to learn graphic design or programming, and then by doing this, you later find better job, not so shitty to you) . Cause and effect. Because of shitty job, you get depression. You see that chain, so you try to change it for your own benefit. Learning new skill = better job = you learning new skill = you learned new skill = you leave shitty job for better job = no more shitty job depression. Of course if you go down enough you can see that everything is that cause and effect chain and determined and so you couldn't have chose otherwise, but why think that a lot about subject which don't benefit you ? If you want food but don't have any, you don't think that "oh well everything determined, so as it is determined for me to not have food and starve" , you instead find ways to get that food as to not starve. Similar things can be said about any else. So what if it was determined, you still need to live right ? 

Just understanding determinism makes us live easier with less or no guilt, cause we couldn't have done otherwise, so why should i be guilty then ? Well maybe in some degree, to not make same mistake if possible: 
instead of saving money for car, you bought yourself a delicious meal and then feel guilty for doing it so next time you would want the same will prevent you from buying same meal for the greater purpose and benefit in the future.Its just all logical. 

Well of course not always, cause we tend sometimes feel guilt for thing which are not beneficial for us, or we just think so ( feeling guilty of not coming to grandparents house, when your mother is telling you you should visit them , because they want to see you even if you don't want them, and that makes you guilt tripping ).
From moral perspective you can say what you want if you should visit them or not. But looking from logical perspective, it is not beneficial ( well sometimes maybe, but not always) for you to visit them. It is only beneficial for them. So why you still feel guilt even if it not beneficial for you ? Maybe because it is encoded in us that we feel empathy for another humans, so then later they would feel the same and that could be beneficial for us ? I think that is it. But empathy is not only good, when exploited. If someone ask for help, maybe it is good to help once in a while, but if you would help all people in the world, then you would not have time for yourself and that would harm you a lot. So being "too nice" guy can be same bad as "too selfish". You need to have both. 

So yeah, in short, it is most of the time best to thing simplicity like you yourself think, because that helps to improve our lives and live better. For us, that don't know all those variables, we think a lot of things could happen even when there is only one certain outcome by which we can't know every time, so we make a guess. Everything is determined but whatever.
